text: Abanca is the Galician banking ally of Banesco Internacional; Banesco Internacional states that its founder and principal shareholder, the banker and economist Juan Carlos Escotet Rodríguez, is also the principal shareholder of Abanca.
short: Banesco Internacional says its founder and principal shareholder Juan Carlos Escotet Rodríguez is also Abanca's principal shareholder.

source.name: Banesco Internacional, 'Nosotros'
source.quote: El fundador y principal accionista de Banesco Internacional es el banquero y economista Juan Carlos Escotet Rodríguez, quien también es el principal accionista de nuestro aliado ABANCA
